verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Unleash supports variants for A/B testing and impact-metrics with simple threshold-based rollout gating, but there is no mention of a documented statistics engine, significance testing methodology (Bayesian or frequentist), or variance-reduction techniques (e.g., CUPED) behind experiment results. missing for 10: any documentation of a statistics engine, confidence-interval/p-value calculation methodology, Bayesian vs frequentist choice, or variance-reduction options.
